1.

O what a blessed world, Where sin cannot reach! Our soul is now taught by the Spirit To eagerly long for it.

2.

And this world of light, Far above the earth raised, There is our home, our Father’s house Of blessedness and joy.

3.

Our soul shall enjoy In eternity long A sweet rest, for God Himself is Its joy and song of gladness.

4.

Our God fills all, Where all is measureless. A host of saints without number Bears forth His praise and worship.

5.

In glory so clear As precious jasper stone His love yet more wondrous Far surpasses its radiance.

6.

Our God, whom we have learned In Jesus to know here, Content with all His own work In love rests there.

7.

And Jesus Christ, God’s Son, Firstborn among many brethren, He, who has suffered the cross’s woe, Is all heaven’s song.

8.

Thy love, O our God, Can fill every soul And gives now in heavenly light That which soon shall be our portion.
